research.searchCoverage: Official Ahrefs API v3 (Bearer token, GET /v3/subscription-info/limits-and-usage is free and consumes no units, GET /v3/site-explorer/metrics, GET /v3/site-explorer/metrics-by-country, GET /v3/keywords-explorer/overview, output=json), Singapore operator identity, and dated incident search for Ahrefs / Ahrefs Pte Ltd security breach/incident reviewed on 2026-09-13. Google Search malvertising impersonating Ahrefs is third-party phishing, not an Ahrefs compromise. No qualifying current unresolved Ahrefs customer-data compromise was identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official Ahrefs API v3 at https://api.ahrefs.com/v3 with Bearer tokens was confirmed on 2026-09-13. GET /subscription-info/limits-and-usage is documented as free. Operator is AHREFS PTE. LTD., Singapore. Dated incident search found no qualifying unresolved Ahrefs compromise.

incidents.finding: Third-party Google Search malvertising impersonated Ahrefs. That is phishing against Ahrefs users, not an Ahrefs platform compromise.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to official GET /v3/subscription-info/limits-and-usage, documented as free and consuming no API units.
Native always sends output=json, matching pinned buildAhrefsUrl.

Native category is utility (source Marketing / Data are not in Rust CATEGORIES). Site Explorer and Keywords Explorer reads consume API units and are not used as healthcheck. Raw JSON is returned under data instead of the upstream {data} unwrap. The upstream user-agent is not sent.
Maps to official GET /v3/site-explorer/metrics. volumeMode maps to volume_mode. This endpoint consumes API units; it is not the healthcheck.

Maps to pinned GET /v3/keywords-explorer/overview with required country and select. Optional keywords, target, and limit are exposed. targetMode, targetPosition, keywordListId, volume monthly dates, where, orderBy, and timeout are omitted. Consumes API units.
